question: Under matched observation, predictor and action budgets, does ego route switching interact with reactive pedestrian motion to create transient coverage/risk/progress changes beyond actuation delay and simple conservative controls?
claim_boundary: Diagnostic interaction, not a new safety method or theorem
Simulator effect is not native VLA or actual human effect
Observed coverage/risk association alone does not identify calibration-mediated causality
Source code constraints are static findings, not reproduced failures

abot.scope: Selected point-goal evaluator only; no reactive physical-time execution contract identified

thor.role: Potential observational analysis, not counterfactual deployment benchmark

clocks.ordering: Observe current physical state; release only scores whose targets are observed; update calibration; issue timestamped forecasts/radii; choose ego command; apply due queued command; compute human action from current pre-integration ego state; advance both; log terminal state before reset

event.type: change intermediate route while retaining final goal
event.geometry_requirement: Symmetric route lengths/feasibility; freeze exact geometry before execution
event.pairing: Clone pre-event state, histories, calibration and all RNG streams within each reaction/delay/controller cell; hold/switch branches share exogenous inputs but not endogenous human trajectories
event.eligibility: Alive at event under common prefix; all pre-event failures retained separately; no post-event success filtering

predictor.name: causal constant-velocity from two observed positions
predictor.velocity_source: Difference of valid observed positions divided by their physical timestamps; no human true velocity/goal access
predictor.missing_rule: No fabricated zero score or compressed time; flag invalid forecasts and use shared conservative fallback
predictor.occlusion_and_reappearance: Contract fixtures first, not performance claims

methods.name: fixed per-horizon empirical margin
methods.radius_source: Frozen calibration split, finite-sample empirical quantile; no exchangeability guarantee claimed

methods.name: timestamp-aware DtACI adaptation
methods.reference: GenSafeNav dt_aci/one_step_dtai.py; one calibrator per horizon
methods.boundary: Adapter with delayed target-time joins, not author implementation reproduction; no inherited theorem

methods.name: rolling empirical quantile
methods.boundary: Simple descriptive baseline, not certified coverage

shared_controller.family: finite-action receding-horizon collision avoidance with route progress cost
shared_controller.fallback: stop command with logged reason, subject to same actuation queue
shared_controller.clip_boundary: Saturation counted; capped coverage never treated as raw ACI certificate

rng.rule: Do not share mutable global RNG across environment and calibrator

splits.unit: scene-family plus seed, never adjacent frames
splits.freeze_rule: Disjoint family definitions, unique IDs and split hash before pilot; test cannot set event, thresholds or method choice

analyst_only: true track generation mapping for auditing
information_boundary.oracle_test: Changing analyst-only future/goal fields while keeping observation and RNG equal must not change the command

log_contract.output_format: JSONL proposed, no rollout artifact yet

units.time: physical seconds, integer tick recorded additionally
units.score_used: boolean; nonconformity value recorded separately in metres

log_contract.null_rule: Missing/unmatured/unavailable remains null with reason; never silently zero or compressed
log_contract.terminal_rule: Preserve final state and times before reset; no new episode state enters old path length
log_contract.track_rule: Generation changes on replacement; prediction/mask/radius permutation must agree

analysis.primary: Per delay and method: paired difference of post-event risk/progress between switch and hold, contrasted between reactive and nonreactive cells
analysis.estimand_boundary: Event-conditioned simulator interaction, not isolated causal mediation by calibration
analysis.unit: paired episode clustered by scene; no independent-frame confidence interval
analysis.shadow_calibration: Run all calibrators on identical logged reference-controller forecast/observation streams for predictor/calibrator separation; this is not a deployment effect
metrics: Any swept-disc collision per episode and post-event window
Duration with disc clearance <=0.25m, plus minimum actual clearance
Success, timeout, no-progress/deadlock, final goal distance and path length
Per-horizon applied-radius coverage with matured and missing denominators
Fallback, clipping saturation, dropped/replaced track counts
Human progress/path deviation versus a separately matched no-ego reference if implemented; otherwise NOT_MEASURED
analysis.terminal_and_censoring: Collision is absorbing failure through risk window; never drop collided episodes. Early success reported with exposure duration; pre-event failures reported outside event-conditioned sample.
analysis.no_progress_rule: Proposed: <0.1m ego displacement over a 5s window while >0.5m from goal; distinguish voluntary wait and blocked progress in logs
analysis.recovery_time: Exploratory only; window size and minimum valid targets to freeze before pilot; unrecovered cases censored, never zero
analysis.significance: No threshold or research-power claim from three smoke scenes

requires: Dockerfile, image digest, adapter revision and command

checks: robot visibility affects human input; source order respected
actuation delay advances physical world; inference wall time not substituted

requires: bounded pilot scope selected after contract results
gates.note: Draft manifest completion does not automatically start an effect pilot; decide scope from the contract results.

requires: reactive pedestrian dynamics and native evaluator

next_task.scope: Implement only missing contract adapter/fixtures and qualify in local Docker; stop before effect pilot or learning
next_task.failure_action: Preserve executable=false and concrete blocker; no host fallback

stop_or_revise: Fixed margin/wait/hysteresis explains outcome at comparable progress and cost
Effect only in artificial reaction law
